reason: This is a cross-cutting change to bootstrap/session initialization contracts across `pkg/session`, `pkg/kv`, and `pkg/store`, not a local fix. Removing `sessionBootstrapped` can affect first-start bootstrap, upgrade/bootstrap ordering, session creation assumptions, and store-driver behavior. The presence of bootstrap and upgrade tests suggests user-visible startup/runtime correctness risk rather than pure cleanup, so it is central enough to justify a focused deep review for high-severity regressions.
